objective: Restore QuickCheck web browser redirect after a secure Supabase handoff without changing native or permission behavior
productionBaselineEvidence: Prior production had async quickcheck-handoff-mint followed by Linking.openURL; this can be blocked as a popup in browsers. Existing server Edge Function mints URL with one-time handoff code and existing QuickCheck web receiver redeems it.
chosenApproach: Web same-tab location.assign after validated server-issued handoff; preserve native Linking behavior
selectionRationale: Navigates reliably after async token mint without opening a popup, preserving authorization and avoiding new-tab orphan windows.
alternativeApproaches: Preopen about:blank window before await and navigate it after token mint
Same-tab location.assign after validated token mint
acceptanceChecks: QuickCheck secure handoff minted and destination validated
Web redirects within same tab after async mint
Vercel production protection permits intended authenticated user access
No claim of production without verified web deployment
preserveBehaviors: No bypass of Supabase handoff mint or QuickCheck token redemption
No unverified production OTA or Android changes
No changes to Classroom/Quiz authorization or scope routing
